book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: Corintosha keranguemulachi Pablo' pilla kiika pallu

content: Jesucristo' kuinda mijakaamula
Tsa' mitya Dios lalanu tenbitya' entsangues nenu tireñuya, ipijpajtyaiñuu i' dyanu kendetyuyu.

Lalaya tiba yujtyanchin pantsudinuu jumulaya kityu deeyu, tsaju' lalaya bibu' ke' anbuda keewares neba indetyuyu, tsenmin Diosa' palaa mijakares nendu bain ne vera' manbatis nendetyuyu. Tsa jutyu', lalaya naajuñuba uwain tsandita nendetsuyu, tsejtaa lala naaju chachilla' kerachiba lala' tenbu' pensasha ti ujchaba tajtu katawanu Diosa' ajuusha.
Tsaaren juntsa Diosa' mika ura kuinda aseeta ityu ju' jalichi daaviyaañuu jushu juntsaa, livee ityu' piyainuu jumu chachillachin juntsaañuu juuve.

Cristo' mika ura kuindaya ya naaju tsamantsaa ju'ba juntsaatala laapu' pamuve, tsenmin Cristoren Dios naaju tsamantsaa juñuba juntsaa keewara juve. Entsa mika ura kuindaya ñillu juuñuu danjuru kentsuñu bain, keranguityu chachillaya katatyu deeve, matyu yaichi Dios juuñuu mandanguen chu' firu' kekaamuya katakaatyu juñu' mitya.

Tsejtu lalaya maali ura' katawachi tenñu kuinda juu pas nendetyuyu; tsa jutyu', Jesucristonu laapu' pa' lala' Bale Rukuve tis nendetsuyu, tsenmala lalaya ñuichi tiba kiikemu juuya kurandetsuyu, Jesúsnu estya' ya' taawasha kes nendetsu' mityaren.

Matyu kaspele dishkejtsa tene juunuren danguisa timu Diosren naa lala' pensasha bain dangaakeñuu kive, tsenmalaa laa bain veelanu dangaamu junudetsu, Dios naaju' tsamantsaa juñuba Jesucristo' mityan juntsaa dekeemijakaandu.
Taaju induba keranguen chunu

Tsaaren lala entsa tsamantsa balee jumu lala' bulunaa chujti' tanañu denayu, tsejtu tu piyama juuñuu jumu lala' bulunaa uukare' detanayu, tsenmalaa entsa tsamantsaa pudee lalanaa fale' jamu jutyuñu, Diosnaa fale' jamuñuba tsangue keewaanutsu.
Tsa' mityaa naa ti peletuba detaa chu' bain, naaken tsaa dechutyuyu, tsenmin titalaba pensaa chu' bain, naa-ichunga tyan dechutyuyu.
Lalanu firu' kenu bendaa deneñu bain, ne laa tene juu dejutyuyu; naa lalanu detsun-ere' bain, petse petse ke' tsungaañuuya kindetyuve.

Lala nuka ji-i' bain, Jesús naa-i taaju in chumuwaañuba laa bain juntsa taajuren in chuñuu katawandetsuyu, tsaju' Jesúsnu meenguendetsu' mityaa naa-uwanuba peyainuu is nendetsuyu. Tsenmin lalanu keekituren mijanu dejuve naa Jesúsya pemulanu bain manchuwaanuu juñuba.
Entsaañu' mityaa lalaya peyainuuya indetsuñuba, ñullaya chunuuya indetsuve.
Diosa' Kiikanu entsandive: Uwain tsaave tenna keenguiyu, tsa' mityaa payu,
ti' pillave. Tsenñu laa bain tsaren uwain tsaave tya' dekeengue' mityaa pamu deeyu.
Tsenmin lala mideeyu naa Bale Ruku Jesús peyañu mangujtemu Diosren, naa lalanu bain Jesúsnu naake' mangujtemu ju'ba tsangue' ñuiba buluren lalanu ya' chuinsha miya' jinuuñu bain.

Tsejtu kumuinchi entsaa de-i' puintsumiya ñuichi uraanuu itaa tsaive, tsenmalaa pure' chachilla Dioschi tiba ura' indetsunmala, tsaren pure' chachilla Diosnu yuj urave tinudetsu, tsangue' Diosnu tsamantsa aawa juve ti' keewaanu.
Tsenñu' mityaa ipijpajtyaiñuu ityu' jintsu', naamika lala' buluya ruku' kantsuñuba, lala' tainsha pensaya malumere kasa mandiya' jijiintsuñuu kiikendetsuyu.
Entsa tusha taaju in chudenaashu juntsalaya, naa taaju' bain, maratu jei puimu ne juuve, tsejturen tsangue taaju kentsu'ba, bene tsamantsa naraa naa-uwanuba de-ityu juuya kakaanu junu tsuve.

Tsaju' lalaya challa tiba katawamu judeeshu juntsalanuya keetyuñuu deju', chaiba tiba kataatyu jumulanaa keekiñuu kemu deeyu. Tiba katawamulaya mandinbu de-i' pullañu bain, kataatyu jumulaya naa-uwanuba tsanamu deeve.
